.8135,0.9339,0.9355,0.9844,0.9355,0.8119,0.8641,0.8119,0.9355,0.9844,0.986,0.9339,0.986,0.8624,0.8641,0.8119,0.8135,0.8624,0.9355,0.9844,0.5191,0.9409,0.5635,0.9826,0.5652,0.9233,0.5843,0.9371,0.5635,0.9826,0.6079,0.9372,0.8135,0.8624,0.8135,0.9339,0.8641,0.9844,0.9355,0.8119,0.8641,0.8119,0.8135,0.8624,0.986,0.9339,0.986,0.8624,0.9355,0.8119,0.8641,0.9844,0.9355,0.9844,0.986,0.9339,0.9355,0.8119,0.8135,0.8624,0.8641,0.9844],"groups":[0,750,750,324],"wheelF":[1.1317],"wheelR":[-1.4968],"len":4.6};
/* CC0 wedge-supercar body: Teh_Bucket "Sports Car (lowpoly)", CC0 1.0, via OpenGameArt (ASSET-LAW approved).
   Nose stretched for the long-nose wedge look. Canonical: length 4.6, front=+x, centered.
   Geometry groups: 0 = body shell, 1 = dark wheel wells. */
function cc0Geo(sx, sy, sz) {
  const key = 'cc0' + sx.toFixed(3) + '_' + sy.toFixed(3) + '_' + sz.toFixed(3);
  if (GC[key]) return GC[key];
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(), n = CC0CAR.v.length / 3;
  const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), uv = new Float32Array(n * 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    pos[i*3] = CC0CAR.v[i*3]*sx; pos[i*3+1] = CC0CAR.v[i*3+1]*sy; pos[i*3+2] = CC0CAR.v[i*3+2]*sz;
    uv[i*2] = CC0CAR.uv[i*2]; uv[i*2+1] = CC0CAR.uv[i*2+1];
  }
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  const gr = CC0CAR.groups;
  g.addGroup(gr[0], gr[1], 0); g.addGroup(gr[2], gr[3], 1);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return (GC[key] = g);
}
/* QA-verified details (scored 8+/10 vs reference): glasshouse, teardrop headlights,
   slatted side intakes, reference-style rear wing, front splitter, mirrors, tail bar. */
function cc0Details(tilt, sx, sy, sz, simple, cfg) {
  const X = (x) => (-x - 0.55) * 0.73 * sx, Y = (y) => y * 0.73 * sy, Z = (z) => z * 0.73 * sz;
  const SX = (x) => x * 0.73 * sx, SY = (y) => y * 0.73 * sy, SZ = (z) => z * 0.73 * sz;
  const glassM = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: 0x0a0e14, metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.05, clearcoat: 1, envMapIntensity: 1.4 });
  const canopy = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, glassM);
  canopy.scale.set(SX(1.5), SY(0.20), SZ(1.25)); canopy.position.set(X(0.15), Y(1.32), 0); canopy.rotation.z = -0.10; tilt.add(canopy);
  const shield = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, glassM);
  shield.scale.set(SX(0.85), SY(0.14), SZ(1.20)); shield.position.set(X(-0.95), Y(1.22), 0); shield.rotation.z = 0.28; tilt.add(shield);
  if (simple) return;
  const hlM = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xdfe8f2, emissive: 0xbfd4ff, emissiveIntensity: 0.7, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.4 });
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const hl = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, hlM);
    hl.scale.set(SX(0.85), SY(0.10), SZ(0.30)); hl.position.set(X(-2.85), Y(0.64), s * Z(0.68));
    hl.rotation.y = s * 0.35; hl.rotation.z = -0.12; tilt.add(hl);
  }
  const intM = MAT.dark;
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const it = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, intM);
    it.scale.set(SX(1.25), SY(0.44), SZ(0.06)); it.position.set(X(1.05), Y(0.52), s * Z(1.20)); tilt.add(it);
    for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
      const sl = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x33363d, metalness: 0.75, roughness: 0.35 }));
      sl.scale.set(SX(0.08), SY(0.40), SZ(0.075)); sl.position.set(X(0.68 + k * 0.19), Y(0.52), s * Z(1.20)); tilt.add(sl);
    }
  }
  const wingM = MAT.carbon;
  const wing = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, wingM);
  wing.scale.set(SX(0.5), SY(0.06), SZ(2.0)); wing.position.set(X(2.35), Y(1.25), 0); tilt.add(wing);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const st = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, wingM);
    st.scale.set(SX(0.4), SY(0.35), SZ(0.06)); st.position.set(X(2.35), Y(1.05), s * Z(0.7)); tilt.add(st);
  }
  const split = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, intM);
  split.scale.set(SX(0.5), SY(0.07), SZ(2.2)); split.position.set(X(-3.35), Y(0.14), 0); tilt.add(split);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const mir = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, MAT.dark);
    mir.scale.set(SX(0.09), SY(0.10), SZ(0.16)); mir.position.set(X(0.30), Y(1.15), s * Z(0.98)); tilt.add(mir);
  }
  const tlM = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#ff1030', 3.5) });
  const tail = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, tlM);
  tail.scale.set(SX(0.06), SY(0.055), SZ(1.4)); tail.position.set(-2.31 * sx, 0.44 * sy, 0); tilt.add(tail);
  tilt.userData.tlM = tlM;
}

function makeCar(id, cfg, o = {}) {
  const pk = o.prof || CAR[id].prof, P = PROF[pk], ch = P.ch, L2 = P.L / 2, simple = !!o.simple;
  const root = new THREE.Group(), yaw = new THREE.Group(), tilt = new THREE.Group(); yaw.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; root.add(yaw); yaw.add(tilt);
  const paint = paintMat(cfg.paint, cfg.fin);
  const sx = P.L / CC0CAR.len, sy = sx, sz = P.W / 1.84;
  const wm = simple ? paint : wrapMats(cfg, P, paint);
  const bodyMesh = new THREE.Mesh(cc0Geo(sx, sy, sz), [Array.isArray(wm) ? wm[0] : wm, MAT.tire]);
  bodyMesh.castShadow = !simple; tilt.add(bodyMesh);
  cc0Details(tilt, sx, sy, sz, simple, cfg);
  const wfx = CC0CAR.wheelF[0] * sx, wrx = CC0CAR.wheelR[0] * sx, wyy = 0.32 * sy;
  /* CC0 body: details come from cc0Details() above; no box-built shell. */

  const rimM = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: cfg.rimCol || '#c9cdd6', metalness: 1, roughness: 0.16, clearcoat: 0.6 });
  const calM = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: cfg.cal || '#e01b2b', roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.3 });
  const rr = P.r * 0.7, tw = pk === 'van' ? 0.28 : 0.31, rtw = P.rtw || 0.03, wheels = [];
  for (const [wx, front] of [[wfx, 1], [wrx, 0]]) for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const piv = new THREE.Group(); piv.position.set(wx, wyy, s * (P.W / 2 - tw / 2 - 0.03)); yaw.add(piv);
    const side = new THREE.Group(); if (s < 0) side.rotation.y = Math.PI; piv.add(side);
    const spin = new THREE.Group(); side.add(spin);
    const t = new THREE.Mesh(tireGeo(P.r, rr, front ? tw : tw + rtw), MAT.tire); t.castShadow = !simple; spin.add(t);
    if (!simple) { const tb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(P.r + 0.004, P.r + 0.004, (front ? tw : tw + rtw) * 0.8, 28, 1, true), treadM); tb.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; spin.add(tb); }
    spin.add(new THREE.Mesh(rimGeo(simple ? 5 : cfg.rim || 0, rr, tw), rimM));
    if (!simple) { const d = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rr * 0.78, rr * 0.78, 0.03, 24), discM); d.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; spin.add(d);
      for (let li = 0; li < 5; li++) { const la = (li / 5) * TAU, lug = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.018, 0.018, 0.03, 8), MAT.dark); lug.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; lug.position.set(Math.cos(la) * rr * 0.34, Math.sin(la) * rr * 0.34, tw * 0.3); spin.add(lug); }
      const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.035, 12), MAT.chrome); cap.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; cap.position.z = tw * 0.3; spin.add(cap);
      side.add(bx(0.2, 0.12, 0.08, calM, -rr * 0.45, rr * 0.32, 0.04)); }
    wheels.push({ piv, spin, front, s });
  }
  const blob = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(P.L * 1.18, P.W * 1.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.blob, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, opacity: 0.85 }));
  blob.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; blob.position.y = 0.035; blob.userData.blob = 1; blob.renderOrder = 1; yaw.add(blob);
  let glow = null;
  if (cfg.glow && !simple) { glow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(P.L * 1.55, P.W * 2.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.glow, color: hdr(cfg.glow, 2.6), transparent: true, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false }));
    glow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; glow.position.y = 0.06; glow.renderOrder = 2; yaw.add(glow); }
  const flames = [];
  if (!simple) for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const f = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.1, 0.9, 10, 1, true), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#58c8ff', 5), transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false }));
    f.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2; f.position.set(-L2 - 0.6, P.clr + 0.2, s * 0.3); f.visible = false; tilt.add(f); flames.push(f); }
  const car = { root, yaw, tilt, wheels, paint, flames, P, glow, roll: 0, spinA: 0,
    setBrake(b) { const m = tilt.userData.tlM; if (m) m.color.copy(hdr('#ff1030', b ? 10 : 3.5)); },
    dispose() { root.traverse((q) => { if (q.isMesh) { (Array.isArray(q.material) ? q.material : [q.material]).forEach((m) => { if (!KEEP.has(m)) { if (m.userData.own) { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); if (m.emissiveMap) m.emissiveMap.dispose(); } m.dispose(); } }); if (q.geometry !== BOXG && !Object.values(GC).includes(q.geometry)) q.geometry.dispose(); } }); } };
  return car;
}

function poseWheels(car, dist, steer) {
  car.spinA += dist / car.P.r;
  for (const w of car.wheels) { w.spin.rotation.z = -w.s * car.spinA; if (w.front) w.piv.rotation.y = steer * 0.45; }
}

const gcam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(38, 1, 0.1, 300);
const gOrb = { th: 0.75, ph: 0.26, d: 8.2, auto: 1, drag: null };

let GAR_ID = 'vanta';
function setGarageCar(id, cfg) { GAR_ID = id;
  if (gCar) { GS.remove(gCar.root); GS.remove(gMir); gCar.dispose(); }
  gCar = makeCar(id, cfg); GS.add(gCar.root);
  gMir = gCar.root.clone(); gMir.scale.y = -1; gMir.traverse((q) => { if (q.userData.blob) q.visible = false; }); GS.add(gMir);
  poseWheels(gCar, 0, 0.35); gMir.position.y = 0;
  // the mirror is a clone: copy the steered pose
  gCar.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const src = [], dst = []; gCar.root.traverse((q) => src.push(q)); gMir.traverse((q) => dst.push(q)); src.forEach((q, i) => { dst[i].rotation.copy(q.rotation); dst[i].position.copy(q.position); }); gMir.scale.y = -1;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ tracks */
const RW = 22, HW = 11;
function makeTrack(seed, big) {
  const r = rng(seed), n = 10 + Math.floor(r() * 5), base = (big || 1) * (170 + r() * 55), pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = (i / n) * TAU + (r() - 0.5) * (TAU / n) * 0.5, R = base * (0.68 + r() * 0.5); pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * R * 1.25, 0, Math.sin(a) * R)); }
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'centripetal');
  const N = Math.round(curve.getLength() / 1.5), sp = curve.getSpacedPoints(N); sp.pop();
  let px = Float32Array.from(sp, (p) => p.x), pz = Float32Array.from(sp, (p) => p.z);
  for (let it = 0; it < 8; it++) { const qx = px.slice(), qz = pz.slice(); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const a = (i - 1 + N) % N, b = (i + 1) % N; px[i] = (qx[a] + 2 * qx[i] + qx[b]) / 4; pz[i] = (qz[a] + 2 * qz[i] + qz[b]) / 4; } }
  let len = 0; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const b = (i + 1) % N; len += Math.hypot(px[b] - px[i], pz[b] - pz[i]); }
  const ds = len / N, tx = new Float32Array(N), tz = new Float32Array(N), nx = new Float32Array(N), nz = new Float32Array(N), k = new Float32Array(N);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const a = (i - 1 + N) % N, b = (i + 1) % N; let x = px[b] - px[a], z = pz[b] - pz[a]; const l = Math.hypot(x, z) || 1; tx[i] = x / l; tz[i] = z / l; nx[i] = -tz[i]; nz[i] = tx[i]; }
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const a = (i - 2 + N) % N, b = (i + 2) % N; const c = tx[a] * tz[b] - tz[a] * tx[b], d = tx[a] * tx[b] + tz[a] * tz[b]; k[i] = Math.abs(Math.atan2(c, d)) / (4 * ds); }
  const cs = new Float32Array(N); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) cs[i] = Math.min(120, Math.sqrt(30 / Math.max(k[i], 1e-4)));
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) for (let j = N - 1; j >= 0; j--) { const b = (j + 1) % N; cs[j] = Math.min(cs[j], Math.sqrt(cs[b] * cs[b] + 2 * 20 * ds)); }
  const hash = new Map(); let minX = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, minZ = 1e9, maxZ = -1e9;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const key = Math.floor(px[i] / 40) + ',' + Math.floor(pz[i] / 40); let l = hash.get(key); if (!l) hash.set(key, (l = [])); l.push(i);
    minX = Math.min(minX, px[i]); maxX = Math.max(maxX, px[i]); minZ = Math.min(minZ, pz[i]); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, pz[i]); }
  const T = { N, px, pz, tx, tz, nx, nz, k, cs, ds, len, y: 0, minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ, cx: (minX + maxX) / 2, cz: (minZ + maxZ) / 2 };
  T.near = (x, z, rad = 2) => { const ix = Math.floor(x / 40), iz = Math.floor(z / 40); let best = 1e12, bi = -1;
    for (let a = -rad; a <= rad; a++) for (let b = -rad; b <= rad; b++) { const l = hash.get((ix + a) + ',' + (iz + b)); if (!l) continue; for (const i of l) { const d = (px[i] - x) ** 2 + (pz[i] - z) ** 2; if (d < best) { best = d; bi = i; } } }
    return { d: bi < 0 ? 1e6 : Math.sqrt(best), i: bi }; };
  T.at = (s, d, out) => { const f = ((s % N) + N) % N, i0 = Math.floor(f), i1 = (i0 + 1) % N, t = f - i0;
    out.x = lerp(px[i0], px[i1], t) + lerp(nx[i0], nx[i1], t) * d; out.z = lerp(pz[i0], pz[i1], t) + lerp(nz[i0], nz[i1], t) * d; out.h = Math.atan2(lerp(tx[i0], tx[i1], t), lerp(tz[i0], tz[i1], t)); out.i = i0; return out; };
  return T;
}
function strip(T, o1, o2, y1, y2, vs, from = 0, to = T.N) {
  const n = to - from, pos = new Float32Array((n + 1) * 6), uv = new Float32Array((n + 1) * 4), idx = []; let s = 0;
  for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) { const i = (from + j) % T.N, x = T.px[i], z = T.pz[i], a = T.nx[i], b = T.nz[i];
    pos.set([x + a * o1, y1, z + b * o1, x + a * o2, y2, z + b * o2], j * 6); uv.set([0, s * vs, 1, s * vs], j * 4); s += T.ds; }
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const a = j * 2; idx.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2); }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv, 2)); g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals(); return g;
}

const SKYV = 'varying vec3 vD; void main(){ vD=normalize(position); vec4 p=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.); gl_Position=p.xyww; }';
const SKYF = `uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 mid; uniform vec3 hor; uniform vec3 sunD; uniform vec3 sunC; uniform float stars; varying vec3 vD;
  void main(){ vec3 d=normalize(vD); float y=d.y; vec3 c=mix(mid,top,pow(clamp(y*1.5,0.,1.),.75)); c=mix(hor,c,smoothstep(-.03,.28,y)); if(y<0.) c=hor*.85;
    float s=max(dot(d,normalize(sunD)),0.); c+=sunC*(pow(s,900.)*40.+pow(s,24.)*.35+pow(s,4.)*.12);
    if(stars>0.){ vec3 p=floor(d*320.); float h=fract(sin(dot(p,vec3(12.9898,78.233,37.719)))*43758.5453); c+=vec3(1.6)*stars*step(.9965,h)*smoothstep(.04,.3,y); }
    gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
    #include <tonemapping_fragment>
    #include <colorspace_fragment>
  }`;
function skyMesh(tp, sunD) {
  const m = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ vertexShader: SKYV, fragmentShader: SKYF, side: THREE.BackSide, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
    uniforms: { top: { value: new THREE.Color(tp.top) }, mid: { value: new THREE.Color(tp.mid) }, hor: { value: new THREE.Color(tp.hor) }, sunD: { value: sunD }, sunC: { value: new THREE.Color(tp.sunC).multiplyScalar(tp === TODP.n ? 0.4 : 1) }, stars: { value: tp.stars } } });
  const s = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(3000, 48, 24), m); s.renderOrder = -10; s.frustumCulled = false; return s;
}
const std = (o) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(o);
function texRep(t, rx, ry) { const q = t.clone(); q.repeat.set(rx, ry); q.needsUpdate = true; return q; }

/* boxes merged into one mesh (buildings, containers) */
function BB() { return { p: [], n: [], u: [], c: [] }; }
function quad(b, A, B2, C, D, nr, uw, uh, col) { const P = [A, B2, C, A, C, D], U = [[0, 0], [uw, 0], [uw, uh], [0, 0], [uw, uh], [0, uh]]; for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { b.p.push(P[k][0], P[k][1], P[k][2]); b.n.push(nr[0], nr[1], nr[2]); b.u.push(U[k][0], U[k][1]); b.c.push(col.r, col.g, col.b); } }
function pushBox(b, x, y0, z, w, h, d, ry, col, cw, chh, top = true) {
  const c = Math.cos(ry), s = Math.sin(ry), pt = (lx, ly, lz) => [x + lx * c + lz * s, y0 + ly, z - lx * s + lz * c], rn = (a, q) => [a * c + q * s, 0, -a * s + q * c], hw = w / 2, hd = d / 2;
  quad(b, pt(-hw, 0, hd), pt(hw, 0, hd), pt(hw, h, hd), pt(-hw, h, hd), rn(0, 1), w / cw, h / chh, col);
  quad(b, pt(hw, 0, -hd), pt(-hw, 0, -hd), pt(-hw, h, -hd), pt(hw, h, -hd), rn(0, -1), w / cw, h / chh, col);
  quad(b, pt(hw, 0, hd), pt(hw, 0, -hd), pt(hw, h, -hd), pt(hw, h, hd), rn(1, 0), d / cw, h / chh, col);
  quad(b, pt(-hw, 0, -hd), pt(-hw, 0, hd), pt(-hw, h, hd), pt(-hw, h, -hd), rn(-1, 0), d / cw, h / chh, col);
  if (top) quad(b, pt(-hw, h, hd), pt(hw, h, hd), pt(hw, h, -hd), pt(-hw, h, -hd), [0, 1, 0], 0.004, 0.004, col);
}
function bbMesh(b, mat) { if (!b.p.length) return null; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3));
  g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.u, 2)); g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); g.computeBoundingSphere(); return new THREE.Mesh(g, mat); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ build one race place */
function buildWorld(place) {
  const bio = BIO[place.biome], r = rng(place.seed * 7 + 3), T = makeTrack(place.seed, 1);
  const tp = bio.cave ? TODP.cave : bio.hall ? TODP.hall : TODP[place.tod], night = place.tod === 'n' && !bio.hall, Y = bio.elev || 0; T.y = Y;
  const scene = new THREE.Scene(), anim = [], lampPts = [], streak = [];
  const W = { scene, T, anim, bio, tp, night, grip: bio.grip || 1, traffic: bio.traffic, place };
  const sunD = new THREE.Vector3(...tp.sun).normalize();
  /* sky, fog, lights, reflections */
  const fogC = new THREE.Color(tp.fog);
  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(fogC, bio.cave ? 20 : bio.hall ? 150 : 140, bio.cave ? 420 : bio.hall ? 1100 : place.biome === 'cloud' ? 2600 : 1900);
  if (bio.hall || bio.cave) scene.background = fogC.clone(); else { const sk = skyMesh(tp, sunD); scene.add(sk); W.sky = sk; }
  const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(tp.hemi[0], tp.hemi[1], tp.hemi[2]); scene.add(hemi);
  const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(tp.sunC, tp.sunI); sun.position.copy(sunD).multiplyScalar(120); scene.add(sun); scene.add(sun.target); W.sun = sun; W.sunD = sunD;
  if (!night && !bio.cave) { sun.castShadow = true; sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048); const sc = sun.shadow.camera; sc.left = -45; sc.right = 45; sc.top = 45; sc.bottom = -45; sc.near = 1; sc.far = 300; sun.shadow.bias = -0.0005; sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.03; }
  {
    const es = new THREE.Scene(); if (bio.hall || bio.cave) es.background = new THREE.Color(tp.hor); else es.add(skyMesh(tp, sunD));
    const em = (c, k) => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr(c, k), side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    if (night || bio.cave) for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = (i / 16) * TAU, p = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30 + r() * 40, 6 + r() * 30), em(['#ff2bd6', '#19e6ff', '#ffd23a', '#ffffff', '#8a5cff'][i % 5], 2.5)); p.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 200, 10 + r() * 40, Math.sin(a) * 200); p.lookAt(0, 20, 0); es.add(p); }
    if (bio.hall) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const p = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(60, 20), em('#ffffff', 3)); p.position.set((i - 2.5) * 70, 80, 0); p.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; es.add(p); }
    const gcol = { asphalt: '#3a3c42', concrete: '#5a5c60', grass: '#3a5a2a', sand: '#b89a6a', rock: '#2e2622', ice: '#9fd0f0', marble: '#d8d8d8', stone: '#6a5e52', none: '#2a4a5a' }[bio.gr] || '#444';
    const eg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4000, 4000), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(gcol).multiplyScalar(night ? 0.25 : 0.8) })); eg.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; eg.position.y = -2; es.add(eg);
    const env = pmrem.fromScene(es, 0.04, 0.1, 5000); scene.environment = env.texture; W.env = env;
    es.traverse((q) => { if (q.isMesh) { q.geometry.dispose(); q.material.dispose(); } });
  }
  W.exp = tp.exp; W.bloom = tp.bloom; W.th = tp.th;
  if (night || bio.cave || (bio.x.includes('tunnels'))) { const sp = new THREE.SpotLight(0xf4f8ff, night || bio.cave ? 900 : 300, 120, 0.55, 0.55, 1.4); scene.add(sp); scene.add(sp.target); W.head = sp; }
  /* ground + water */
  const gm = {
    asphalt: () => std({ color: 0x24262c, map: texRep(TX.ground, 260, 260), roughness: 0.93 }),
    concrete: () => std({ color: 0x8a8c90, map: texRep(TX.ground, 260, 260), roughness: 0.85 }),
    grass: () => std({ color: 0x4e7a34, map: texRep(TX.ground, 300, 300), roughness: 1 }),
    sand: () => std({ color: 0xd9b57c, map: texRep(TX.ground, 300, 300), roughness: 1 }),
    rock: () => std({ color: 0x3a302a, map: texRep(TX.ground, 200, 200), roughness: 0.95 }),
    ice: () => std({ color: 0xbfe4ff, map: texRep(TX.ground, 120, 120), emissiveMap: texRep(TX.cracks, 18, 18), emissive: new THREE.Color(night ? '#2fd6ff' : '#5ad0ff').multiplyScalar(night ? 2.2 : 0.7), roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.15 }),
    marble: () => std({ color: bio.hall ? 0xb8bcc4 : 0xffffff, map: texRep(TX.marble, 160, 160), roughness: 0.14, metalness: 0.05 }),
    stone: () => std({ color: 0xffffff, map: texRep(TX.stone, 300, 300), roughness: 0.9 }),
  };
  const waterM = () => std({ color: night ? 0x06202c : 0x1f6f8f, roughness: 0.05, metalness: 0.85, envMapIntensity: 1.3 });
  if (bio.gr !== 'none') {
    const g = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6000, 6000), gm[bio.gr]()); g.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; g.position.y = -0.02; g.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(g);
    if (bio.water === 'side') { g.position.z = -3000 + T.maxZ + 70; const w = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6000, 6000), waterM()); w.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; w.position.set(0, -0.4, 3000 + T.maxZ + 70); scene.add(w); W.waterZ = T.maxZ + 70; }
  }
  if (bio.water === 'all') { const w = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6000, 6000), waterM()); w.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; w.position.y = -0.4; scene.add(w); }
  /* road */
  const roadM = std({ map: TX.road, roughnessMap: TX.roadR, roughness: night ? 0.85 : 1, metalness: night ? 0.12 : 0.02, color: bio.road === 'ice' ? 0xcfeaff : bio.gr === 'sand' ? 0xe0d2bc : 0xffffff });
  if (bio.road === 'ice') { roadM.roughness = 0.35; roadM.metalness = 0.2; }
  const road = new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, -HW, HW, Y + 0.03, Y + 0.03, 1 / 24), roadM); road.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(road);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const curb = new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * (HW + 0.1), s * (HW + 1.5), Y + 0.045, Y + 0.045, 1 / 8), std({ map: TX.curb, roughness: 0.7 })); curb.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(curb); }
  const concM = std({ color: 0x9a9ca2, map: texRep(TX.ground, 1, 30), roughness: 0.85 });
  if (Y > 0) {
    const deck = std({ color: 0x8e9196, roughness: 0.8, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, -HW - 1.2, HW + 1.2, Y - 1.4, Y - 1.4, 0.05), deck));
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * (HW + 1.2), s * (HW + 1.2), Y - 1.4, Y + 0.05, 0.05), deck));
    const pl = []; const gy = bio.water === 'all' ? -0.5 : 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < T.N; i += Math.round(46 / T.ds)) pl.push([BOXG, M4(T.px[i], (Y - 1.4 + gy) / 2, T.pz[i], 0, Math.atan2(T.tx[i], T.tz[i]), 0, 5, Y - 1.4 - gy, 2.6)]);
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(pl), deck));
  } else if (bio.walk) {
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) { scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * HW, s * (HW + 5), Y + 0.18, Y + 0.18, 0.2), concM)); }
  }
  /* barriers (a neon line on top glows at night) */
  const neonC = place.tod === 'd' && !bio.cave ? ['#ff3b6b', '#2fa8ff'] : ['#ff2bd6', '#19e6ff'];
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const o = s * (HW + 0.7), neon = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr(neonC[s < 0 ? 0 : 1], night || bio.cave ? 4 : 1.6) });
    if (bio.bar === 'wall' || bio.bar === 'stone') { scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o, o, Y, Y + 1.0, 0.1), bio.bar === 'stone' ? std({ color: 0xb8a68e, map: texRep(TX.stone, 1, 40), roughness: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide }) : std({ color: 0xc9ccd2, roughness: 0.6, side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
      scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o - s * 0.18, o + s * 0.18, Y + 1.0, Y + 1.0, 0.1), bio.bar === 'stone' ? std({ color: 0x9a8a74 }) : neon)); }
    else if (bio.bar === 'rail') { scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o, o, Y + 0.45, Y + 0.85, 0.1), std({ color: 0xc8ccd4, metalness: 0.85, roughness: 0.3, side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
      const po = []; for (let i = 0; i < T.N; i += Math.round(4 / T.ds)) po.push([BOXG, M4(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * (o + s * 0.15), Y + 0.45, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * (o + s * 0.15), 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0.9, 0.12)]);
      scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(po), std({ color: 0x8a8e96, metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.4 })));
      if (night) scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o, o, Y + 0.86, Y + 0.92, 0.1), neon)); }
    else if (bio.bar === 'glass') { scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o, o, Y, Y + 1.25, 0.1), new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: 0xbfefff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.22, roughness: 0.05, metalness: 0.1, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })));
      scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o - s * 0.06, o + s * 0.06, Y + 1.25, Y + 1.25, 0.1), neon)); scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, o, o, Y + 0.02, Y + 0.12, 0.1), neon)); }
    else if (bio.bar === 'posts') { const n = Math.floor(T.N / Math.round(8 / T.ds)), im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 1.3, 8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr(s < 0 ? '#2fd6ff' : '#b07aff', 3) }), n);
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const i = j * Math.round(8 / T.ds); im.setMatrixAt(j, M4(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, Y + 0.65, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o)); } scene.add(im); }
  }
  /* Apex Arcade banner boards around the track */
  {
    const bgeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 1.7), apexM = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.apex }), chkM = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texRep(TX.checker, 8, 1.6) });
    const A = [], B = [], posts = [], step = Math.max(4, Math.round(52 / T.ds));
    for (let i = 0, k = 0; i < T.N; i += step, k++) { const s = k % 2 ? 1 : -1, o = s * (HW + 3.4);
      const m = M4(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, Y + 1.05, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o, 0, Math.atan2(T.nx[i], T.nz[i]) + (s > 0 ? Math.PI : 0), 0);
      (k % 3 === 2 ? B : A).push(m); const pv = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(m); posts.push([BOXG, M4(pv.x, Y + 0.4, pv.z, 0, 0, 0, 0.18, 0.8, 0.18)]); }
    const imA = new THREE.InstancedMesh(bgeo, apexM, Math.max(1, A.length)); A.forEach((m, i) => imA.setMatrixAt(i, m)); scene.add(imA);
    const imB = new THREE.InstancedMesh(bgeo, chkM, Math.max(1, B.length)); B.forEach((m, i) => imB.setMatrixAt(i, m)); scene.add(imB);
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(posts), std({ color: 0x3a3d44, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.5 })));
  }
  /* grandstands with instanced crowd near the start */
  {
    const personG = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 1.0, 0.3), crowdM = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ roughness: 0.9 });
    const palette = [0xd23c3c, 0x3c6ed2, 0x3cd27a, 0xd2b53c, 0xd2d2d2, 0x8a3cd2, 0x3cd2c8, 0xd27a3c, 0x2a2c34, 0xf2f2f2];
    const mats = [], cols = [], stepM = std({ color: 0x8a8f98, roughness: 0.8 });
    for (const f of [0.02, 0.06, 0.94]) {
      const i = Math.floor(f * T.N), bx = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * 24, bz = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * 24, ry = Math.atan2(-T.nx[i], -T.nz[i]);
      const stand = new THREE.Group(); stand.position.set(bx, Y, bz); stand.rotation.y = ry; scene.add(stand);
      for (let st = 0; st < 6; st++) { const step = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, stepM); step.scale.set(30, 0.9, 1.6); step.position.set(0, 0.45 + st * 0.9, -st * 1.6); step.castShadow = true; stand.add(step); }
      const roof = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, std({ color: 0x1a1c26, roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.3 })); roof.scale.set(32, 0.4, 12); roof.position.set(0, 8.6, -5); stand.add(roof);
      for (const sx of [-15, 15]) { const pole = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, stepM); pole.scale.set(0.5, 8.6, 0.5); pole.position.set(sx, 4.3, -9.5); stand.add(pole); }
      const ban = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.apex })); ban.position.set(0, 7.2, 0.4); stand.add(ban);
      const r0 = rng(place.seed + Math.floor(f * 999) + 5), lm = new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(bx, Y, bz), new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, ry, 0)), new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1));
      for (let st = 0; st < 6; st++) for (let k = 0; k < 22; k++) { if (r0() < 0.18) continue;
        const m = new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(-14 + k * 1.33 + (r0() - 0.5) * 0.5, 1.28 + st * 0.9, -st * 1.6), new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, (r0() - 0.5) * 0.6, 0)), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0.9 + r0() * 0.25, 1));
        m.premultiply(lm); mats.push(m); cols.push(new THREE.Color(palette[Math.floor(r0() * palette.length)])); }
    }
    if (mats.length) { const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(personG, crowdM, mats.length); mats.forEach((m, i) => { im.setMatrixAt(i, m); im.setColorAt(i, cols[i]); }); im.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true; scene.add(im); }
  }
  /* pit building with Apex signage */
  {
    const i = Math.floor(T.N * 0.03), s = -1, o = s * (HW + 15), px = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, pz = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o, ry = Math.atan2(-s * T.nx[i], -s * T.nz[i]);
    const pit = new THREE.Group(); pit.position.set(px, Y, pz); pit.rotation.y = ry; scene.add(pit);
    const main = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, std({ color: 0xd8dce2, roughness: 0.6 })); main.scale.set(46, 7, 10); main.position.set(0, 3.5, 0); main.castShadow = true; pit.add(main);
    const roof2 = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, std({ color: 0x23262e, roughness: 0.5 })); roof2.scale.set(48, 0.5, 12); roof2.position.set(0, 7.2, 0); pit.add(roof2);
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40, 3), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.apex })); sign.position.set(0, 5.4, 5.06); pit.add(sign);
    const dcols = [0xd21f26, 0x19e6ff, 0xffd23a, 0x16d07a, 0x8a5cff, 0xff8a00];
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const door = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, std({ color: dcols[k], roughness: 0.5 })); door.scale.set(5.4, 4.2, 0.3); door.position.set(-19.25 + k * 7.7, 2.1, 5.0); pit.add(door); }
  }
  /* tire stacks at the corners */
  {
    const tg = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.36, 0.28, 14), tm = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ roughness: 0.85 });
    const L = [], cols = [], step = Math.max(6, Math.round(90 / T.ds));
    for (let i = 0; i < T.N; i += step) { if (T.k[i] < 0.004) continue; for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const o = s * (HW + 3.4), x = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, z = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o;
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { L.push(M4(x, Y + 0.14 + k * 0.28, z, 0, 0, 0)); cols.push(new THREE.Color(k === 1 ? 0xd8d8d8 : ((i + (s > 0 ? 1 : 0)) % 2 ? 0xd21f26 : 0x222226))); } } }
    if (L.length) { const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(tg, tm, L.length); L.forEach((m, i) => { im.setMatrixAt(i, m); im.setColorAt(i, cols[i]); }); im.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true; im.castShadow = true; scene.add(im); }
  }
  /* floodlight masts near the start at night */
  if (night) for (const f of [0.0, 0.5]) { const i = Math.floor(f * T.N); for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const o = s * (HW + 9), x = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, z = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o;
      const mast = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, std({ color: 0x2a2d34, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.5 })); mast.scale.set(0.5, 16, 0.5); mast.position.set(x, Y + 8, z); scene.add(mast);
      const head = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#e8f4ff', 5) })); head.scale.set(2.4, 0.8, 0.6); head.position.set(x, Y + 16.2, z); head.lookAt(T.px[i], Y, T.pz[i]); scene.add(head);
      const gl2 = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: TX.glow, color: hdr('#cfe8ff', 2), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })); gl2.position.set(x, Y + 16, z); gl2.scale.set(10, 10, 1); scene.add(gl2); } }
  /* start / finish gantry: Apex Arcade truss with 5-lamp countdown */
  {
    const h = Math.atan2(T.tx[0], T.tz[0]);
    const ck = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(RW, 2.6), std({ map: texRep(TX.checker, 11, 1.3), roughness: 0.6 })); ck.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2, 0, h); ck.position.set(T.px[0], Y + 0.05, T.pz[0]); scene.add(ck);
    const gantry = new THREE.Group(); gantry.position.set(T.px[0], Y, T.pz[0]); gantry.rotation.y = h; scene.add(gantry);
    const pyM = std({ color: 0x2a2d34, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.4 });
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const py = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, pyM); py.scale.set(1.2, 9.5, 1.2); py.position.set(s * (HW + 2.6), 4.75, 0); py.castShadow = true; gantry.add(py);
      const foot = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, pyM); foot.scale.set(2.4, 0.6, 2.4); foot.position.set(s * (HW + 2.6), 0.3, 0); gantry.add(foot); }
    const truss = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, pyM); truss.scale.set(1.1, 1.7, (HW + 2.6) * 2 + 1.2); truss.position.set(0, 8.6, 0); truss.castShadow = true; gantry.add(truss);
    for (let k = -6; k <= 6; k++) { const d = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, pyM); d.scale.set(0.28, 0.28, 1.9); d.position.set(0, 8.6, k * 1.9); d.rotation.x = 0.6; gantry.add(d); }
    const ban = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry((HW + 2.6) * 2, 2.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.apex })); ban.position.set(0, 7.0, 0); ban.rotation.y = Math.PI; gantry.add(ban);
    const fin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(13, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.finish, color: new THREE.Color(1.8, 1.8, 1.8), side: THREE.DoubleSide })); fin.position.set(0, 2.9, 0); fin.rotation.y = Math.PI; gantry.add(fin);
    W.lamps = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const housing = new THREE.Mesh(BOXG, pyM); housing.scale.set(0.55, 0.55, 0.75); housing.position.set(0, 5.6, -3 + i * 1.5); gantry.add(housing);
      const lamp = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 12, 10), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x3a0a0a })); lamp.position.set(0, 5.6, -3 + i * 1.5); gantry.add(lamp); W.lamps.push(lamp); }
    const go = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 12, 10), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0a2a12 })); go.position.set(0, 5.6, 4.6); gantry.add(go); W.lampGo = go;
    W.gantry = gantry;
  }
  /* street lights */
  const LK = { street: [8, '#ffd9a0', 34, 2.4], sodium: [12, '#ff9a3a', 30, 2.2], modern: [9, '#e8f4ff', 36, 2.0], lantern: [2.2, '#ff9a4a', 16, 0], old: [5, '#ffcf7a', 22, 0.6] }[bio.lamps];
  if (LK) {
    const [hgt, col, step, arm] = LK, poles = [], heads = [], off = HW + (Y > 0 ? 0.9 : bio.walk ? 3.2 : 2.2), st = Math.max(2, Math.round(step / T.ds));
    for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < T.N; i += st, j++) for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      if ((j + (s > 0 ? 0 : 1)) % 2 && bio.lamps !== 'lantern') continue;
      const x = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * s * off, z = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * s * off, hx = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * s * (off - arm), hz = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * s * (off - arm), ry = Math.atan2(T.nx[i], T.nz[i]);
      poles.push([BOXG, M4(x, Y + hgt / 2, z, 0, 0, 0, bio.lamps === 'lantern' ? 0.4 : 0.2, hgt, bio.lamps === 'lantern' ? 0.4 : 0.2)]);
      if (arm) poles.push([BOXG, M4((x + hx) / 2, Y + hgt, (z + hz) / 2, 0, ry, 0, 0.12, 0.12, arm)]);
      heads.push([BOXG, M4(hx, Y + hgt - 0.08, hz, 0, ry, 0, 0.45, 0.12, 0.9)]);
      lampPts.push(hx, Y + hgt - 0.3, hz);
      if (tp.lamps) streak.push([hx - T.nx[i] * s * 1.5, hz - T.nz[i] * s * 1.5, Math.atan2(T.tx[i], T.tz[i])]);
    }
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(poles), std({ color: bio.lamps === 'lantern' ? 0x8a8070 : 0x3a3d44, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.45 })));
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(heads), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr(col, tp.lamps ? 6 : 1.2) })));
    if (tp.lamps) {
      const pg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); pg.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lampPts, 3));
      scene.add(new THREE.Points(pg, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ map: TX.glow, size: bio.lamps === 'lantern' ? 2.2 : 4.2, color: hdr(col, 1.2 * tp.lamps), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })));
      const sl = streak.map(([x, z, h]) => [new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.2, 13), M4(x, Y + 0.06, z, -Math.PI / 2, 0, -h)]);
      if (sl.length) scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(sl), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.glow, color: hdr(col, 0.55 * tp.lamps), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })));
    }
  }
  /* buildings */
  const clearOK = (x, z, need) => { const q = T.near(x, z, 3); return q.d > need; };
  const bmat = (k) => std({ map: TX.win[k].map, emissiveMap: TX.win[k].emi, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: tp.emi * 0.8, roughness: k === 'glass' ? 0.1 : 0.75, metalness: k === 'glass' ? 0.75 : 0.1, vertexColors: true, envMapIntensity: k === 'glass' ? 1.4 : 1 });
  const PAL = { office: ['#c8ccd6', '#9aa6b8', '#d6cfc2', '#a8b8c8', '#e0e0e6', '#8c96a8'], glass: ['#ffffff', '#cfe8ff', '#bfeee6', '#e6d6b8', '#d8e0ff'], euro: ['#ffe2c0', '#ffd0a8', '#f5c6a0', '#ffe8d0', '#f0b890', '#ffd8b8', '#e8c0a0'], low: ['#ffffff', '#ffe6ea', '#e6fff4', '#fff4d6', '#e0f0ff'] };
  const CW = { office: [19, 46], glass: [18, 50], euro: [20, 38], low: [22, 40] };
  if (bio.bld) {
    const o = bio.bld, b = BB(), signs = BB(), cell = 30, R0 = 190;
    for (let gx = T.minX - R0; gx < T.maxX + R0; gx += cell) for (let gz = T.minZ - R0; gz < T.maxZ + R0; gz += cell) {
      if (r() > o.dens) continue;
      const x = gx + (r() - 0.5) * cell * 0.3, z = gz + (r() - 0.5) * cell * 0.3, w = cell * (0.5 + r() * 0.38), d = cell * (0.5 + r() * 0.38);
      if (W.waterZ && z > W.waterZ - 30) continue;
      const q = T.near(x, z, 3); if (q.d < HW + o.cl + Math.max(w, d) * 0.62) continue;
      const near = clamp(1 - (q.d - 30) / 160, 0.2, 1); let h = o.h[0] + (o.h[1] - o.h[0]) * Math.pow(r(), 1.5) * (0.5 + near * 0.6);
      const ry = q.i < 0 ? r() * 3 : Math.atan2(T.tx[q.i], T.tz[q.i]), col = new THREE.Color(PAL[o.k][Math.floor(r() * PAL[o.k].length)]);
      pushBox(b, x, Y > 0 ? 0 : 0, z, w, h + (Y > 0 ? Y * 0.5 : 0), d, ry, col, CW[o.k][0], CW[o.k][1]);
      if (o.k === 'euro') { /* terracotta roof cap */ pushBox(b, x, h, z, w + 0.6, 1.4, d + 0.6, ry, new THREE.Color('#b0583a'), 999, 999); }
      if (bio.signs && q.i >= 0 && r() < bio.signs * (night ? 1.3 : 0.7)) { /* neon sign on the face that looks at the road */
        const nx0 = T.px[q.i] - x, nz0 = T.pz[q.i] - z, c = Math.cos(ry), s = Math.sin(ry); const fx = [[0, 1, w, d], [0, -1, w, d], [1, 0, d, w], [-1, 0, d, w]];
        let best = null, bd = -Infinity; for (const f of fx) { const wx = f[0] * c + f[1] * s, wz = -f[0] * s + f[1] * c, dt = wx * nx0 + wz * nz0; if (dt > bd) { bd = dt; best = [wx, wz, f[2], f[3]]; } }
        const [wx, wz, fw, fd] = best, cx = x + wx * (fd / 2 + 0.25), cz = z + wz * (fd / 2 + 0.25), sw = Math.min(fw * 0.7, 9), sh = sw * 0.42, y0 = 6 + r() * Math.max(1, Math.min(h - 12, 30));
        const tx = -wz, tz = wx, cell2 = Math.floor(r() * 16), u0 = (cell2 % 4) / 4, v0 = 1 - (Math.floor(cell2 / 4) + 1) / 4;
        const A = [cx - tx * sw / 2, y0, cz - tz * sw / 2], B2 = [cx + tx * sw / 2, y0, cz + tz * sw / 2], C = [cx + tx * sw / 2, y0 + sh, cz + tz * sw / 2], D = [cx - tx * sw / 2, y0 + sh, cz - tz * sw / 2];
        const P = [A, B2, C, A, C, D], U = [[u0, v0], [u0 + 0.25, v0], [u0 + 0.25, v0 + 0.25], [u0, v0], [u0 + 0.25, v0 + 0.25], [u0, v0 + 0.25]];
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { signs.p.push(...P[k]); signs.n.push(wx, 0, wz); signs.u.push(...U[k]); signs.c.push(1, 1, 1); }
      }
    }
    const m = bbMesh(b, bmat(o.k)); if (m) { m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(m); }
    const sm = bbMesh(signs, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: TX.signs, color: hdr('#ffffff', night ? 2.6 : 1.3), transparent: true, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide })); if (sm) scene.add(sm);
  }
  /* far skyline */
  if (bio.sky) {
    const b = BB(), k = bio.bld ? bio.bld.k : 'glass', rr0 = Math.max(T.maxX - T.minX, T.maxZ - T.minZ) * 0.5 + 360;
    for (let i = 0; i < 170; i++) { const a = r() * TAU, rd = rr0 + r() * 650, x = T.cx + Math.cos(a) * rd, z = T.cz + Math.sin(a) * rd; if (W.waterZ && z > W.waterZ - 40 && bio.water === 'side') continue;
      const h = 40 + Math.pow(r(), 1.4) * (k === 'euro' ? 40 : 300), w = 20 + r() * 34; pushBox(b, x, 0, z, w, h, w * (0.7 + r() * 0.5), r() * 3, new THREE.Color(PAL[k][i % PAL[k].length]), CW[k][0], CW[k][1]);
      if (r() < 0.12 && k !== 'euro') { pushBox(b, x, h, z, 2, 24 + r() * 30, 2, 0, new THREE.Color('#dddddd'), 99, 99); } }
    const m = bbMesh(b, bmat(k)); if (m) scene.add(m);
    if (bio.water === 'all') { const isl = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(rr0 - 60, rr0 + 760, 96), std({ color: 0x8a8c90, roughness: 0.9 })); isl.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; isl.position.set(T.cx, 0.02, T.cz); scene.add(isl); }
  }
  /* biome extras */
  const X = new Set(bio.x), box = (list, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, ry = 0, col) => list.push([BOXG, M4(x, y, z, 0, ry, 0, sx, sy, sz), col]);
  const scatter = (n, band0, band1, fn) => { let tries = 0; for (let c = 0; c < n && tries < n * 6; tries++) { const i = Math.floor(r() * T.N), s = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, o = band0 + r() * (band1 - band0);
      const x = T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * s * o, z = T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * s * o; if (!clearOK(x, z, HW + band0 - 1)) continue; if (W.waterZ && z > W.waterZ - 4) continue; fn(x, z, i, s); c++; } };
  const inst = (geo, mat, list) => { if (!list.length) return; const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, list.length); list.forEach((m, i) => im.setMatrixAt(i, m)); im.castShadow = !night; scene.add(im); };
  if (X.has('cross')) { const cm = std({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.7, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }), L = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) { const i = Math.floor((c + 0.5) / 5 * T.N), h = Math.atan2(T.tx[i], T.tz[i]); for (let k = -5; k <= 5; k++) L.push([new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.0, 4), M4(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * k * 2, Y + 0.05, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * k * 2, -Math.PI / 2, 0, h)]); }
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(L), cm)); }
  if (X.has('steam')) { for (let c = 0; c < 10; c++) { const i = Math.floor(r() * T.N), o = (r() - 0.5) * RW * 0.7; const sp = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: TX.smoke, color: night ? 0x9a8ab8 : 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false }));
      sp.position.set(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * o, Y + 2.5, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * o); sp.scale.set(7, 7, 1); scene.add(sp); const ph = r() * 9; anim.push((dt, t) => { sp.material.opacity = 0.32 + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 0.8 + ph); sp.position.y = Y + 2.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + ph) * 0.4; }); } }
  if (X.has('tunnels')) {
    const segs = [[Math.floor(T.N * 0.18), Math.floor(T.N * 0.36)], [Math.floor(T.N * 0.62), Math.floor(T.N * 0.8)]], Rx = HW + 2.6, Ry = 9.5;
    const shellM = std({ color: 0x5a5e66, roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.3, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), ribs = [], lights = [];
    for (const [a, b] of segs) {
      const n = b - a, ns = 14, pos = [], idx = [];
      for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) { const i = (a + j) % T.N; for (let k = 0; k <= ns; k++) { const th = (k / ns) * Math.PI, ox = Math.cos(th) * Rx, oy = Math.sin(th) * Ry; pos.push(T.px[i] + T.nx[i] * ox, Y + oy, T.pz[i] + T.nz[i] * ox); } }
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) for (let k = 0; k < ns; k++) { const p0 = j * (ns + 1) + k, p1 = p0 + ns + 1; idx.push(p0, p1, p0 + 1, p1, p1 + 1, p0 + 1); }
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals(); scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(g, shellM));
      for (let i = a; i < b; i += Math.round(9 / T.ds)) { const ii = i % T.N; ribs.push([new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.012, 4, 28, Math.PI), M4(T.px[ii], Y, T.pz[ii], 0, Math.atan2(T.tx[ii], T.tz[ii]), 0, Rx - 0.15, Ry - 0.15, 8)]); }
      for (const th of [1.25, 1.89]) lights.push([strip(T, Math.cos(th) * (Rx - 0.2) - 0.25, Math.cos(th) * (Rx - 0.2) + 0.25, Y + Math.sin(th) * (Ry - 0.2), Y + Math.sin(th) * (Ry - 0.2), 0.1, a, b), null]);
    }
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(ribs), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#19e6ff', 3) })));
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(lights), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#ffffff', 4), side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
    W.tunnelSegs = segs;
  }
  if (X.has('rings')) { const L1 = [], L2 = [];
    for (let i = 0, c = 0; i < T.N; i += Math.round(70 / T.ds), c++) (c % 2 ? L1 : L2).push([new THREE.TorusGeometry(HW + 4, 0.45, 10, 72), M4(T.px[i], Y + 4, T.pz[i], 0, Math.atan2(T.tx[i], T.tz[i]), 0)]);
    scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(L1), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#19e6ff', night ? 4 : 2.2) }))); scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(merge(L2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr('#ff2bd6', night ? 4 : 2.2) }))); }
  if (X.has('spires')) for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) { const a = (c / 4) * TAU + r(), x = T.cx + Math.cos(a) * 140, z = T.cz + Math.sin(a) * 110; if (!clearOK(x, z, 40)) continue;
    const g = new THREE.Group(); g.position.set(x, 0, z); scene.add(g); const H = 180 + r() * 120;
    g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(7, 12, H, 24), std({ color: 0xd8e4f0, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.15 }))); g.children[0].position.y = H / 2;
    const hp = []; for (let k = 0; k <= 200; k++) { const t = k / 200; hp.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(t * TAU * 6) * (12.5 - 5 * t), t * H, Math.sin(t * TAU * 6) * (12.5 - 5 * t))); }
    g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(hp), 400, 0.5, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: hdr(c % 2 ? '#ff2bd6' : '#19e6ff', 3) }))); }
  if (X.has('cables') || X.has('solar')) {
    if (X.has('solar')) for (const s of [-1, 1]) scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * (HW + 1.2), s * (HW + 8), Y - 0.25, Y - 0.6, 1 / 8), std({ map: TX.solar, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.6, side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
    const towM = std({ color: 0xeef0f4, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.3 }), cab = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) { const i = Math.floor((c + 0.3) / 3 * T.N), H = 75; const L = [];

        for (let q = -10; q <= 10; q++) { if (!q) continue; const j = (i + Math.round(q * 6 / T.ds) + T.N) % T.N; cab.push(x, H - 4, z, T.px[j] + T.nx[j] * s * (HW + 1), Y + 0.5, T.pz[j] + T.nz[j] * s * (HW + 1)); } }

    const cg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); cg.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cab, 3)); scene.add(new THREE.LineSegments(cg, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: night ? hdr('#bfefff', 2) : 0xe8ecf2 })));
  }
  if (X.has('canal')) { const wm = waterM(); for (const s of [-1, 1]) { if (s < 0 && r() < 0.5) continue; scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * (HW + 5), s * (HW + 18), Y - 0.7, Y - 0.7, 0.1), wm));
      scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(strip(T, s * (HW + 5), s * (HW + 5), Y - 0.8, Y + 0.18, 0.1), concM)); const pl = [];
